purpose: Prove zero-training physical and set-prediction readiness of the geometry-anchored encoder against the sealed observable Teacher V2.

approval.scope: One immutable C01-C08 zero-training readiness V2; no C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner access.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed automatic best-choice execution without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 five-frame organized LiDAR shards.

sampling.rule: Audit every V2 Teacher row/token once; run one deterministic real row from each cardinality 0-5 through the random-initialized encoder and set loss.

teacher.source: Observable Teacher V2 with native LOS plus fixed LiDAR vertical FOV.
teacher.valid_mask: V2 event_mask; padding inactive, zero-event rows retained.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Teacher identity is audit-only; online tokens remain robot-relative/provisional and graph edges remain execution-verified.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Formal command binds only C01-C08 dataset and Teacher V2 hashes; quarantined historical C09 field-shape exposure contributes nothing.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU read-only scan support and one six-row random forward/backward; no trained inference.

failure_policy: Any count, join, support, rotation, permutation, determinism, gradient, source or isolation failure stops before training.
